beats.vo: Ek rat ne ek pedal ek ghante mein saat hazaar baar dabaya, jab tak woh thak ke gir nahi gaya. Kyun? Uske brain ka ek hissa use pleasure de raha tha.

beats.title: Brain ke important parts
beats.vo: Topic ten: brain ke important parts.

beats.note: Brain stem: breathing, basic life. Medulla: heart rate + breathing
beats.vo: Sabse andar brain stem: breathing aur basic life functions. Iska medulla heart rate aur breathing control karta hai.

beats.note: Thalamus: senses ki information filter karke aage bhejta hai; neend mein senses band
beats.vo: Uske upar thalamus: senses se aane wali information filter karke aage bhejta hai, aur neend mein senses ko band karta hai.
Peeche cerebellum, yaani little brain: voluntary movement aur balance coordinate karta hai.
Beech mein limbic system: emotion aur memory. Ismein amygdala, hypothalamus aur hippocampus aate hain.

beats.note: Frontal thinking, planning, judgement · Parietal touch · Occipital vision · Temporal hearing, language
beats.vo: Aur bahar cerebral cortex ke chaar lobes: frontal thinking, planning aur judgement; parietal touch; occipital vision; aur temporal hearing aur language.

beats.title: Emotions ka address
beats.vo: Topic eleven: emotions brain mein kahan rehte hain?
Amygdala, yaani almond: fear aur aggression ko regulate karta hai, khaas kar jab koi cheez threat lagti hai.
Aur prefrontal cortex control center hai: jab ye zyada active hota hai, hum apna gussa control kar paate hain.

beats.note: Hypothalamus: hunger, thirst, temperature, sex · pleasure / reward
beats.vo: Hypothalamus pituitary ke through hormones se judta hai, aur hunger, thirst, temperature aur sex regulate karta hai. Wahi rat wala reward center yahi tha.
Aur hippocampus nayi long-term memories banata hai. Ye damage ho jaaye, to nayi yaadein banti hi nahi.

beats.title: Mind ka body par asar
beats.vo: Topic eight: emotion, thought aur behaviour body ko kaise badalte hain.

beats.title: Stress response
beats.vo: Stress aata hai to HPA axis active hota hai: epinephrine, norepinephrine aur cortisol release hote hain, jo body ko threat ke liye ready karte hain.

beats.title: Selye: General Adaptation Syndrome
beats.vo: Lamba stress chale to Selye ke general adaptation syndrome ke teen stage: alarm, resistance aur exhaustion.

beats.title: Immunity ↓
beats.vo: Aur lamba stress immune system ko kamzor karta hai: zukaam jaldi hota hai, aur zakhm dheere bharte hain.
Isliye thought, emotion aur behaviour sirf mind mein nahi rehte, ye poori body ko badalte hain.
